units.previous_finding: The title uses gendered singular “Pozdravljen” while the page addresses users consistently with plural/polite forms such as “Dobrodošli”, “kliknite” and “pritisnite”; make the address/register consistent. The final “kliknite … [puščica desno] spodaj” is also syntactically incomplete in Slovenian. Keep the glossary label “puščica desno” and link target unchanged, but integrate the link naturally into Slovenian klikniti syntax.

The emphasized visible text “zero value” remains in English in the first paragraph, violating mandatory glossary “zero value → ničelna vrednost” and conflicting with the Slovenian term used later on the same page. Localize the complete visible emphasis span while preserving valid Go Present emphasis structure and range.

The final Note no longer clearly distinguishes the two Go syntax facts from the English source: the three for-clause components do not require parentheses ( ) while braces { } are always required. Restore this explicit contrast without changing the code symbols or Present structure and without adding extra explanation.

判定依据：glossary keep 明确要求技术 identity “goroutine” 原样保留；B 表示译文整体语义清楚、仅有轻微但真实的术语/语言问题，但在当前 A-only gate 下仍必须修订。当前问题：candidate 使用 “goroutini / goroutini” 等 Slovenian 词形变化，直接改变了 keep 技术 identity。Revision 要求：保持 “goroutine” 本身不变，通过周围 Slovenian 句法自然表达双数/数量关系；不得改变 channel、synchronization 或示例技术语义。

判定依据：glossary keep 要求 “goroutine” 与 “mutex” 技术 identity 原样保留；B 表示技术含义仍正确，但存在轻微且真实的术语一致性/Slovenian 句法问题，在 A-only gate 下必须修订。当前问题：出现 “goroutinami”，改变了 keep identity；“sprostitev mutex” 为保留 mutex 而形成不自然的 Slovenian 名词结构。Revision 要求：保持 “goroutine” 和 “mutex” 本身不变，通过重构周围自然语言表达数量、介词与解锁关系；不得改变 sync.Mutex、Lock、Unlock、defer 或 mutual exclusion 技术含义。

判定依据：English “concurrency features” 指 Go 的并发特性/能力/机制，而 glossary 将编程概念 “function” 明确定义为 “funkcija”；B 表示总体语义仍可理解，但存在轻微且真实的术语歧义，在 A-only gate 下必须修订。当前问题：“funkcije sočasnosti” 容易被理解为“并发函数”，偏离 source 的 features。Revision 要求：改为明确表达 Go 的并发特性、能力或机制，避免与 function 概念混淆；继续保持 concurrency → sočasnost 与 parallel execution 的概念边界。
